public_note: Compact source-quality amendment for Noether Papers 14-17 measuring native image resolution of the source PDFs bundled in earlier RA52-RA55 packages.

files.quality_label: Noether RA89 P14-P17 source-PDF native-resolution amendment
files.coverage: Measures earlier P14-P17 source PDFs with pdfimages: P14/P15/P16 embed 120/360 ppi image layers and P17 embeds 600 ppi image layers.
files.limitations: No TeX changes, no source images, no translations, and no reader PDF. It corrects witness-quality interpretation only: earlier 1000 dpi renders are localized visual aids, not native >=1000 dpi source evidence.
files.next_action: For disputed dense formulas or tables in Papers 14-17, either fetch stronger institutional/raw sources or record the source-quality limitation explicitly.
